dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical narrowing of the 2D planar profile starting from the mid-dorsal region and extending to a pointed posterior termination at the peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Subtle asymmetrical bulge on the right lateral margin relative to the more linear left margin; minor edge irregularities consistent with water-surface interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity mature white baseline with minimal grayscale variation across the primary dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Series of faint, parallel linear rake marks oriented diagonally across the central dorsal plane; one prominent dark, circular high-contrast point located anteriorly on the midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple linear, parallel light-colored scars (rake marks) situated on the mid-dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Single prominent dark circular focal point on the anterior dorsal midline.
